 B.
The Ph.D. degree has been obtained from a foreign university/institution with a ranking
among top 500 in the World University Ranking (at any time) by any one of the following: (i)
Quacquarelli Symonds (QS) (ii) the Times Higher Education (THE) or (iii) the Academic
Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of the Sahnghai Jiao Tong University (Shanghai).
HONORARIUM:
The above assignment will be on lecture basis with a token honorarium of Rs. 1500/- per lecture with
an upper limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month as per Panjab University norms. The candidate shall have to
give an undertaking that he/she will not draw any fellowship/stipend or any financial assistance from
any agency till they are in the department as a guest faculty. The candidates who are already availing
JRF scholarships in the University are not entitled for the honorarium but they will be issued
experience certificate for the guest faculty.
